svg.title: A worked example of assembling an app from the commons
svg.desc: The request "text my patients the day before their appointment" becomes a reminder app made of four smaller jobs and seven base tasks. Five base tasks are found in the commons and reused as they are, one comes from the clinic's own private knowledge graph, and one, respect quiet hours, is missing and is built once and then added for everyone. The model writes only the wiring that connects the pieces.
